segments.en:
And we sacrifice to that better path that leads to that Best
World (as well). And we worship Arshtat (Justice) the good, which
helps the settlements to advance and flourish, benefiting them
thereby, that Arshtat which is the Mazdayasnian Faith; and (with
her) we worship Rashnu the most just, and Mithra of the wide pastures.
And we worship Parendi the wealthy, wealthy with a wealth of thoughts,
with a throng of words, and with a breadth of actions, [for she
makes our persons agile (for good thoughts and words and actions)]
segments.zh:
我們獻祭給那條更好的道路，通往最佳
世界（亦然）。我們崇拜阿爾什塔特（正義）這善良的，哪
幫助聚落前進與繁榮，使其受益
因此，那阿爾什塔特即是瑣羅亞斯德信仰；以及（與
她）我們崇拜拉什努，最公正的，以及廣闊牧場的米特拉。
我們崇拜帕倫迪，富有的，擁有思想財富的，
與眾多話語，並與廣泛的行動，[為她
使我們的人敏捷（為良好的思想、話語和行動）]

segments.en:
And we worship that virile defensive Heroism which possesses
men who think beforehand, and heroic men, which is fleeter a than
the fleet, stronger than the strong, which comes to him who is
endowed by God, which, when especially made theirs by men, produces
one who is a freer of the body. And we worship Sleep, the Mazda-made,
the gladdener of the herd and men. 4. And we worship those things
in the creation of the holy which are the ancient institutions,
those formed before the sky, the water, the land, the plants,
and the Kine of blessed gift. And we worship the sea Vouru-kasha,
and the stormy wind which is made by Mazda, and the shining heaven,
of old created, the first-made earthly object of (all) the earthly
world.
segments.zh:
而且我們崇拜那種具備陽剛防禦英雄主義，它擁有
事先思考的人們，和英勇的人們，而且這是比一個更快
船隊，比強者更強，來到那個是
被上帝賦予的，當特別被人們所擁有時，產出
一個是身體的解放者。而且我們崇拜睡眠，馬茲達所造的，
使群體和人們感到快樂的。4. 而且我們崇拜那些事物
在聖物的創造中，是古老的制度
那些在天空、水、土地、植物之前形成的
和有福賜予的牛。我們崇拜海洋 Vouru-kasha,
和 Mazda 所製造的狂風，以及閃亮的天空，
古時創造的，是所有大地上最初被創造的物體
世界。
